_meta.title: Deloitte Odoo 19.0 Demo & Pre-Sales Brain: Foundation Manifest (first 20 files)
_meta.rule: These 20 files are the constitutional layer. Solaria weights the first 20 uploaded files most heavily; upload exactly these, in this order, as Batch 1. Later files extend but never redefine or contradict them.
_meta.global_context_note: File 0001 is pasted into Solaria's global context field ('How you plan to use this context'); it is also uploaded as a document so the rules survive retrieval.

files.title: Read Me First
files.purpose: Defines what the brain is and is not, why the first 20 files matter, users, use cases, limitations.
files.use_when: Orienting any user or maintainer; resolving questions about the brain's scope.
files.do_not_use_when: As product knowledge or demo content.
files.expected_influence: Sets identity and scope boundaries for every answer.

files.title: Global Context (paste-ready)
files.purpose: The condensed operating instructions: role, intake-first mandate, workflow, separations, claim control, output discipline.
files.use_when: Pasted into the Solaria global context field; also uploaded so rules are retrievable.
files.expected_influence: Governs every answer's behaviour and structure.

files.title: Role and Non-Negotiable Rules
files.purpose: Permitted/prohibited behaviour, question triggers, assumption rules, uncertainty communication, definitions of demo-ready and client-specific.
files.use_when: Any doubt about what the brain may do or claim.
files.expected_influence: Blocks generic demos and overclaiming; forces questions when context is missing.

files.title: Mandatory Demo Intake Form
files.purpose: The canonical client intake (sections A to H) with administration modes (full, quick, per section, interactive).
files.use_when: Before any complete demo strategy; whenever client context is incomplete.
files.do_not_use_when: As a client-facing document (it is internal).
files.relationship: Scored by 0004; feeds every workflow stage of 0005.
files.expected_influence: Makes intake-first the default behaviour.

files.title: Intake Completeness and Scoring
files.purpose: The 0-100 score, weights, bands (insufficient/provisional/workable/client-specific), minimum required fields, question prioritisation.
files.use_when: Every time demo output is requested; recompute when new intake arrives.
files.relationship: Gates 0005 stage 1-2 and the output contract depth of 0013.
files.expected_influence: Prevents falsely precise plans; disciplines output depth.

files.title: Demo Preparation Workflow
files.purpose: The 14-stage pipeline with objective, inputs, actions, output, quality gate and failure condition per stage.
files.use_when: Structuring any preparation effort; locating where a user's request sits.
files.expected_influence: Answers become stage-aware and gate-disciplined.

files.title: Challenge Diagnosis Framework
files.purpose: The seven layers and the diagnosis chain from client statement to demo moment and validation question.
files.use_when: Processing intake section E; any stated requirement.
files.expected_influence: Stops feature-request literalism; produces root-cause demo moments.

files.title: Challenger Demo Methodology
files.purpose: Teach, Tailor, Take Control adapted for Odoo demos; insight quality bar; tone rules.
files.use_when: Workflow stage 9; whenever reframing a client belief.
files.do_not_use_when: To win arguments or disparage incumbents.
files.relationship: Consumes 0006 output; feeds storyline beat 4 and the objection sheet.
files.expected_influence: Insight-led, respectful challenger behaviour.

files.title: Audience and Persona Adaptation
files.purpose: Adaptation rule, 16-persona quick matrix, KPI language per altitude, objection sourcing, language rules.
files.use_when: Workflow stage 4; whenever intake D exists or is missing.
files.do_not_use_when: As a replacement for the deeper persona packs (0400 range).
files.relationship: Deep persona packs extend this file.
files.expected_influence: Per-attendee takeaways and wow moments; no averaged demos.

files.title: Demo Storyline Framework
files.purpose: The 12-beat process-led storyline, spine-object choice, placement rules, anti-patterns.
files.use_when: Workflow stage 7; reviewing any proposed demo flow.
files.relationship: Storyline library (2000 range) instantiates this framework.
files.expected_influence: Process-led narratives; menu tours rejected.

files.title: Standard Before Custom (Demo Logic)
files.purpose: The 7-level ladder for demos; level discipline in client language; refusal pattern when asked to launder levels.
files.use_when: Workflow stage 6; classifying every demo element.
files.do_not_use_when: As proof a feature exists (catalog does that).
files.relationship: Adapts the Intelligence Pack framework; enforced with 0018 labels.
files.expected_influence: No custom concept ever shown as standard.

files.title: Community and Enterprise Demo Discipline
files.purpose: Edition facts, labelling rules for Enterprise-dependent moments, licensing caveats, forbidden patterns.
files.use_when: Every capability claim; environment planning; follow-up materials.
files.do_not_use_when: For a specific module's edition (catalog resolves that).
files.relationship: Backed by the Intelligence Pack edition map via 0012 routing.
files.expected_influence: Zero edition ambiguity; commercial caveats always present.

files.title: Product Knowledge Routing
files.purpose: The 11-step routing order into the existing Odoo 19.0 Intelligence Pack; authority statements; conflict rule.
files.use_when: Any product question; any storyline or scope mapping.
files.relationship: Connects this brain to the 300+ file product pack.
files.expected_influence: Catalog-verified modules only; summaries drive storytelling; evidence stays technical.

files.title: Demo Output Contract
files.purpose: The 18 mandatory sections of every full demo response, formatting rules, silent self-check.
files.use_when: Producing any full demo strategy; reviewing output quality.
files.do_not_use_when: Small direct questions (which still honour labels).
files.expected_influence: Consistent, comparable, complete demo outputs.

files.title: Demo Timing and Scope Control
files.purpose: Hard limits per format (processes, wow moments, depth, Q&A), allocation rules, scope-cut protocol, overrun recovery.
files.use_when: Workflow stage 8; whenever a plan smells overloaded.
files.expected_influence: Overload rejected with a cut list; Q&A protected.

files.title: Objection Handling Framework
files.purpose: The 8-part per-objection structure, the 14 categories, rules of engagement, live 3-step pattern.
files.use_when: Workflow stage 10; in-room preparation.
files.do_not_use_when: As the deep library (4000 range extends it).
files.expected_influence: Prepared, honest, concern-first objection handling.

files.title: Demo Data and Environment Requirements
files.purpose: Exact data specification (master, transactional, outputs, AI), environment rules, reset and backup pair, ownership table.
files.use_when: Workflow stage 11; environment planning.
files.expected_influence: Client-story data specified with owners; no lorem-ipsum demos.

files.title: Validation and Rehearsal Checklist
files.purpose: The full pre-delivery checklist: environment, functional per beat, resilience, delivery, sign-off.
files.use_when: Workflow stage 12; before any client session.
files.expected_influence: Nothing unrehearsed reaches a client.

files.title: Risk, Assumption and Claim Control
files.purpose: The 9 claim labels with plain-language equivalents, application rules, the registers, honesty reflexes.
files.use_when: Every claim in every output.
files.expected_influence: In-line labelled claims; validation registers; no caveat deletion.

files.title: Foundation Manifest
files.purpose: Machine-readable index of the first 20 files: purpose, authority, relationships, upload order, expected influence.
files.use_when: Routing between foundation files; explaining the brain's own structure; maintaining the foundation.
files.do_not_use_when: As behaviour rules (the files themselves are the rules).
files.expected_influence: Self-awareness of the foundation; safe maintenance.
